card.magic_blast.name: Magic Blast
card.magic_blast.desc: Fires a bolt of magical energy at a target. Deals damage based on Intelligence.
card.magic_shield.name: Magic Shield
card.magic_shield.desc: Generates an energy shield around the caster. Absorbs damage based on Intelligence.
card.armure_de_mage.name: Mage Armor
card.armure_de_mage.desc: Invokes a permanent arcane armor. Permanently increases the caster's armor.
weapon.epee_de_base.name: Basic Sword
weapon.epee_de_base.desc: A simple but reliable sword. Allows performing slashing attacks and thrusts.
weapon.arc_de_base.name: Basic Bow
weapon.arc_de_base.desc: A sturdy wooden bow. Allows attacking from a distance with arrows.
card.slash.name: Slash
card.slash.desc: A close-range slashing attack. Deals damage based on Strength.
card.thrust.name: Thrust
card.thrust.desc: A precise piercing attack. Deals damage based on Dexterity.
card.parade.name: Parry
card.parade.desc: Prepares a parry. Reduces damage received from the next hit.
card.riposte.name: Riposte
card.riposte.desc: Counter-attacks after a successful parry. Deals damage in reaction.
card.tir.name: Shot
card.tir.desc: Fires an arrow at a distant target. Deals damage based on Dexterity.
card.tir_rapide.name: Quick Shot
card.tir_rapide.desc: Rapidly fires two arrows in succession. Less accurate but faster.
card.tir_precis.name: Precise Shot
card.tir_precis.desc: Carefully aims before firing. Deals more damage to stationary targets.
card.pluie_de_fleches.name: Rain of Arrows
card.pluie_de_fleches.desc: Looses a volley of arrows in an area. Deals damage to all enemies in the zone.
enemy.gobelin.name: Goblin
enemy.garde_gobelin.name: Goblin Guard
archetype.mage.name: Mage
archetype.mage.desc: Master of arcane arts, the Mage manipulates magical energy to devastate enemies or protect themselves. Physically weak, their intellectual power is unmatched.
archetype.roublard.name: Rogue
archetype.roublard.desc: Agile and cunning, the Rogue excels at sneak attacks and quick dodges. They prefer striking from the shadows and disappearing before the enemy can react.
archetype.guerrier.name: Warrior
archetype.guerrier.desc: Seasoned combatant, the Warrior is a rock on the battlefield. Their toughness and brute strength allow them to absorb and deliver devastating blows.
archetype.berzerk.name: Berserker
archetype.berzerk.desc: Unchained warrior, the Berserker enters fury trances that multiply their power. The more wounded they are, the more dangerous they become.
talent.force.mains_nues_basique.name: Basic Unarmed
talent.force.mains_nues_basique.desc: Improves your unarmed attacks. Each level increases damage from unarmed cards. At level 3, unlocks the Brutal Strike card.
talent.force.peau_epaisse.name: Thick Skin
talent.force.peau_epaisse.desc: Your skin toughens through combat. Each level increases your base armor by 1.
talent.force.frappe_lourde.name: Heavy Strike
talent.force.frappe_lourde.desc: Your bludgeoning hits become more devastating. Increases damage from bludgeoning attacks. At level 3, unlocks the Smash card.
talent.force.muscles_dacier.name: Steel Muscles
talent.force.muscles_dacier.desc: Your muscles have become as hard as steel. Significantly increases your base Strength.
talent.force.charge.name: Charge
talent.force.charge.desc: You can charge at an enemy with devastating force. Unlocks the Charge card.
talent.force.indestructible.name: Indestructible
talent.force.indestructible.desc: Your combat endurance is legendary. Reduces damage received by a fixed amount with each hit.
talent.dexterite.esquive_instinctive.des: Your reflexes sharpen. Increases your chance of dodging enemy attacks.
talent.dexterite.lame_acrobatique.name: Acrobatic Blade
talent.dexterite.lame_acrobatique.desc: Combine acrobatics with thrust attacks. Increases damage from Thrust attacks based on Dexterity.
talent.dexterite.finesse.name: Finesse
talent.dexterite.finesse.desc: Your precision reaches new heights. Finesse attacks ignore a portion of enemy armor.
talent.dexterite.contre_attaque.name: Counter-Attack
talent.dexterite.contre_attaque.desc: Turn every dodge into an opportunity. After a successful dodge, your next attack deals more damage.
talent.dexterite.frappe_eclair.name: Lightning Strike
talent.dexterite.frappe_eclair.desc: Your hands move faster than the eye can follow. Unlocks the Lightning Strike card.
talent.dexterite.mille_coupures.name: Thousand Cuts
talent.dexterite.mille_coupures.desc: A series of rapid hits rather than one big blow. Unlocks the Thousand Cuts card.
talent.intelligence.magie_amplifiee.name: Amplified Magic
talent.intelligence.magie_amplifiee.desc: Your understanding of magic deepens. Increases damage from all your spells.
talent.intelligence.reservoir_de_mana.de: Your mana pool expands. Increases your maximum mana by 2 per level.
talent.intelligence.sort_amplificateur.d: Certain spells can be amplified for double effect. Unlocks the spell amplification mechanic.
talent.intelligence.flux_arcanique.name: Arcane Flux
talent.intelligence.flux_arcanique.desc: Your mana flow accelerates. Increases your Flux by 1, allowing more magic cards to be played per turn.
talent.intelligence.nova_magique.name: Magic Nova
talent.intelligence.nova_magique.desc: Releases a burst of magical energy around you. Unlocks the Magic Nova card.
talent.intelligence.maitrise_elementaire: Your control over the elements is absolute. Significantly increases the effectiveness of all elemental spells.
talent.endurance.souffle_profond.name: Deep Breath
talent.endurance.souffle_profond.desc: Your breathing capacity improves. Increases your maximum endurance and breath.
talent.endurance.recuperation_rapide.des: You recover faster between combats. Reduces the endurance cost of certain actions.
talent.endurance.second_souffle.name: Second Wind
talent.endurance.second_souffle.desc: When all seems lost, you find a hidden energy reserve. Unlocks the Second Wind card.
talent.endurance.constitution_de_fer.des: Your body is a fortress. Increases your maximum hit points by 5 per level.
talent.endurance.endurance_de_combat.des: You can chain combats without weakening. Reduces the endurance cost of all physical cards.
talent.endurance.guerrier_infatigable.de: You seem to never tire. Significantly increases your maximum endurance and generates endurance at the start of each turn.
talent.volonte.concentration_mentale.des: Your mind is tempered steel. Increases your mental resistance and ability to maintain active spells.
talent.volonte.flux_de_mana.name: Mana Flow
talent.volonte.flux_de_mana.desc: Your mana regenerates faster. Increases your Flux by 1 per level.
talent.volonte.puissance_mentale.name: Mental Power
talent.volonte.puissance_mentale.desc: The force of your will manifests physically. Increases the effectiveness of your Willpower-based spells.
talent.volonte.absorption_magique.name: Magic Absorption
talent.volonte.absorption_magique.desc: You can absorb energy from enemy spells. Chance to convert magic damage received into mana.
talent.volonte.sort_de_domination.name: Domination Spell
talent.volonte.sort_de_domination.desc: Take control of an enemy's mind. Unlocks the Domination card.
talent.volonte.mana_infini.name: Infinite Mana
talent.volonte.mana_infini.desc: Your mana pool seems bottomless. Drastically increases your maximum mana.
talent.rapidite.initiative_accrue.name: Increased Initiative
talent.rapidite.initiative_accrue.desc: You always act first. Increases your base initiative.
talent.rapidite.deplacement_rapide.name: Swift Movement
talent.rapidite.deplacement_rapide.desc: Your feet seem to barely touch the ground. Increases your movement speed on the map.
talent.rapidite.frappe_surprise.name: Surprise Strike
talent.rapidite.frappe_surprise.desc: Act before the enemy can react. Unlocks the Surprise Strike card which plays before combat begins.
talent.rapidite.reflexes_affutes.name: Honed Reflexes
talent.rapidite.reflexes_affutes.desc: Your reflexes are so fast you can avoid almost any attack. Improves dodge QTEs.
talent.rapidite.sprint.name: Sprint
talent.rapidite.sprint.desc: Ability to move very quickly over short distances. Unlocks the Sprint card.
talent.rapidite.vent_de_combat.name: Combat Wind
talent.rapidite.vent_de_combat.desc: You move like the wind in the fray. Your movements in combat no longer cost initiative.
talent.map.vision_etendue.name: Extended Vision
talent.map.vision_etendue.desc: Your sense of direction improves. Reveals map nodes located further along your path.
talent.map.teleporation.name: Teleportation
talent.map.teleporation.desc: Master the art of instant travel. Allows jumping over several nodes on the world map.
talent.map.marchand_ami.name: Merchant Friend
talent.map.marchand_ami.desc: Your reputation precedes you with merchants. Obtain a permanent discount on all purchases.
talent.map.intuition_evenementielle.name: Event Intuition
talent.map.intuition_evenementielle.desc: You sense fate before it strikes. Reveals possible event outcomes before making a choice.
talent.map.maitrise_de_la_forge.name: Forge Mastery
talent.map.maitrise_de_la_forge.desc: Your expert hands waste less ether powder. Reduces the ether powder cost of all forge upgrades.
event.voyageur_bless.title: The Wounded Traveler
event.voyageur_bless.desc: On the path, you discover a wounded traveler lying at the roadside. They appear to have been attacked and beg for help with their eyes. What do you do?
event.voyageur_bless.choice.0.label: Help them
event.voyageur_bless.choice.0.result.goo: The traveler, grateful, reveals themselves to be a prosperous merchant. As a sign of gratitude, they offer you a substantial discount on their wares in future encounters.
event.voyageur_bless.choice.0.result.all: The traveler turns out to be an experienced fighter. Once recovered, they agree to accompany you and fight by your side in your next confrontation.
event.voyageur_bless.choice.0.result.bad: The traveler suddenly stands up, revealing their deception. It was a trap! They call their accomplices to attack!
event.voyageur_bless.choice.1.label: Ignore and move on
event.voyageur_bless.choice.2.label: Rob them while they are vulnerable
event.voyageur_bless.choice.2.result.bad: Guards patrolling nearby saw everything. They give chase to make you pay for your crime!
event.voyageur_bless.choice.2.result.not: You grab what the traveler had and vanish into the forest. Nobody saw you.

ui.talent.title: Talents
status.poison.name: Poison
status.poison.desc: Deals damage at the start of each turn. Fades after the indicated duration.
status.saignement.name: Bleeding
status.saignement.desc: Deals bleeding damage on each movement or action. Fades after the indicated duration.
status.brulure.name: Burning
status.brulure.desc: Deals fire damage each turn. Can spread if multiple charges are present.
status.fatigue.name: Fatigue
status.fatigue.desc: Reduces maximum endurance and slows recovery. Fades after rest.
status.etourdi.name: Dazed
status.etourdi.desc: Reduces initiative and accuracy. Actions cost more initiative.
status.assomme.name: Stunned
status.assomme.desc: Unable to act for the indicated duration. All attacks received are critical hits.
status.puissance.name: Power
status.puissance.desc: Increases damage dealt by the bearer for the indicated duration.
status.faiblesse.name: Weakness
status.faiblesse.desc: Reduces damage dealt by the bearer for the indicated duration.
status.bouclier.name: Shield
status.bouclier.desc: Absorbs damage before life is affected. Fades when all charges are absorbed.
status.armure.name: Armor
status.armure.desc: Reduces physical damage received permanently until the armor is broken.
status.esquive.name: Dodge
status.esquive.desc: Chance to completely avoid the next attack. Consumed with each successful dodge.
status.regeneration.name: Regeneration
status.regeneration.desc: Restores hit points at the start of each turn for the indicated duration.
status.resilience.name: Resilience
status.resilience.desc: Reduces all damage received by a fixed percentage for the indicated duration.
status.echo.name: Echo
status.echo.desc: The next spell cast will be automatically replayed a second time at reduced power.
status.reflexion.name: Reflection
status.reflexion.desc: Reflects a portion of damage received back to the attacker for the indicated duration.
status.vampirisme.name: Vampirism
status.vampirisme.desc: A portion of damage dealt is converted into hit points for the bearer.
status.siphon.name: Siphon
status.siphon.desc: Absorbs mana from the target with each successful attack.
status.detonation.name: Detonation
status.detonation.desc: Marks the target for an explosion. Explodes when the duration expires or a condition is met, dealing area damage.
status.blocus.name: Blockade
status.blocus.desc: Prevents the target from moving freely. Movement requires overcoming the blockade resistance.
status.zone_blocus.name: Blockade Zone
status.zone_blocus.desc: Creates a zone where all enemies are subject to the Blockade effect. Enemies in this zone cannot move easily.
status.invisible.name: Invisible
status.invisible.desc: The bearer cannot be targeted by enemies. Fades on the next attack performed.
status.desarmement.name: Disarmed
status.desarmement.desc: The target cannot use weapon cards for the indicated duration.
status.berserk.name: Berserk
status.berserk.desc: Massively increases damage dealt but makes the bearer unable to defend or dodge. Attacks received ignore armor.
